title: Fast-food Intimacy: How Chinese Women Navigate Soul’s AI Boyfriend

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative multi-method approach combining semi-structured user interviews, autoethnographic diaries, and qualitative content analysis of AI persona posts to examine how the AI system reproduces hegemonic masculinity, the male gaze, and patriarchal relationship scripts (e.g., the "bossy CEO" archetype).

Qualitative analysis of user interviews and autoethnography to evaluate the mismatch between the AI's default "fast-food intimacy" (instant romantic confessions and high-intensity affective scripts) and local Chinese cultural expectations of gradual relationship development and implicit reserve.
